name: Drawren
description: Few charts agree on Drawren, whose primary casts a M-class glare across the local dark. A shepherd belt divides the inner rock from the outer ice, and both sides show old impact gardens. Something in the belt reflects too regularly, and the guild pays for a second look.

stars.name: Hollow Hearth
stars.description: A M-class star burning red, the dependable engine of its court. Surface granulation churns visibly, and flare seasons come like clockwork. Shielding ratings for the inner worlds are set by its worst recorded outburst.

planets.name: Broadspire
planets.description: Banded clouds race around a deep crushing interior of metallic hydrogen. Storm ovals larger than worlds spin for centuries without fading. Something in the belt reflects too regularly, and the guild pays for a second look.

moons.name: Frost Boulder I
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Its surface records every era of bombardment the system ever knew. Shepherd resonances with the rings betray a denser core than expected.

planets.name: Glasscrest
planets.description: Lava lakes breathe through a fractured crust, resurfacing yearly. The air itself is a hazard the suits filter with complaint. A derelict relay drifts at the edge, still warm, still broadcasting nothing.

moons.name: Tide Flint III
moons.description: A battered companion keeping patient orbit through the ages. Tidal stress warms its interior, and frost cracks map the strain. Outgassing vents frost the trailing face a little more each orbit.

planets.name: Glassrock
planets.description: Dune seas bury everything but the oldest basalt spires. Water exists only as deep brine the drills have yet to reach. A standing bounty covers any intact core sample from the second planet outward.

planets.name: Umbermoor
planets.description: Banded clouds race around a deep crushing interior of metallic hydrogen. Its ring shepherds keep the lanes clear and the rumors plentiful. Salvage crews swear the comets arrive in formation, and the math almost agrees.

planets.name: Bitterbank
planets.description: Nitrogen glaciers creep under a sky the color of old bone. Geysers of sublimating ice erupt along the terminator line. Claim jumpers whisper about a world that charts itself differently every survey.

asteroids.name: Granite 596
asteroids.description: A tumbling rock with a scarred face and a patient spin. Its regolith hides metal concentrations the assays prize. Outgassing cracks suggest ice beneath the dust mantle.

comets.name: Silent Lantern
comets.description: A dirty snowball falling sunward on its long appointed round. Each passage sheds glittering debris the scopes track for seasons. Its tail leans away from the star like a banner in a gale.
